node.title: Re: Converting XLSX to CSV with Perl while maintaining the encoding
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
I've been using Spreadsheet::XLSX to convert

Note that according to [mod://Spreadsheet::Read], that module is strongly discouraged in favor of [mod://Spreadsheet::ParseXLSX]. I'd suggest you switch to [mod://Spreadsheet::Read], it also includes an example [https://metacpan.org/source/HMBRAND/Spreadsheet-Read-0.81/examples/xls2csv|xls2csv] and [https://metacpan.org/source/HMBRAND/Spreadsheet-Read-0.81/examples/xlsx2csv|xlsx2csv].

In this case, at least on a test file I have, the issue is that the strings returned from $cell->value() are undecoded UTF-8, and the quick fix is to add utf8::decode($trimcell); right after my $trimcell = $cell->value();.
